'''Hun Duo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He once met with a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Greepo]] in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of [[Nem'ro's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hun Duo first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an easter egg, referencing the meeting between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Hun Duo is classified as a Level 3 Strong Quickshot, while Greepo is a Level 1 Weak Pistoleer, thus acknowledging Solo's [[Han shot first|victory]] over Greedo.
